description: Breastplate of the Chromatic Flight Level 60 To forge the Breastplate of the Chromatic Flight, you will be required to bring the following items to Jeziba the 'Sculptor': 1 Chromatic Carapace. 10 Brilliant Chromatic Scales. 10 Blood of Heroes. 10 Frayed Abomination Stitchings. Requirements: - Brilliant Chromatic Scale x 10 - Blood of Heroes x 10 - Frayed Abomination Stitching x 10
